crossRefs.note: Yahweh makes poor and makes rich. He brings low, he also lifts up.
He raises up the poor out of the dust. He lifts up the needy from the dunghill to make them sit with princes and…
“Therefore Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘I said indeed that your house and the house of your father should walk…
There they were in great fear, where no fear was, for God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you. You…
Behold, I have made you small among the nations. You are greatly despised.
Then my enemy will see it, and shame will cover her who said to me, where is Yahweh your God? Then my enemy will see me…
He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.

parallels.note: Behold, I have made you small among the nations. You are greatly despised.

translations.web: “For, behold, I have made you small among the nations, and despised among men.
translations.bsb: “For behold, I will make you small among nations, despised among men.
translations.kjv: For, lo, I will make thee small among the heathen, and despised among men.
translations.asv: For, behold, I have made thee small among the nations, and despised among men.
